paper_title: Efficient Ensemble for Fine-tuning Language Models on Multiple Datasets
caption: Illustrating the empirical generalization errors and sharpness measures with respect to QLoRA weights. (<ref>) Smaller adapters with a rank of 16 achieve the lowest generalization errors. Additionally, the Hessian trace values correlate with generalization errors, suggesting that smaller adapters tend to converge to flatter minima. (<ref>) An ensemble of k adapters leads to lower generalization errors and Hessian traces. Here, we fix the sum of the dimensions of k adapters to be equal to 256. (<ref>) QLoRA, which is trained on a quantized base model, yields lower generalization errors and Hessian trace values compared to LoRA.

model_annotations.Bulgarian:
Ето описание на предоставената научна линейна графика, спазващо поставените указания:

Графиката илюстрира връзка между две променливи чрез показване на линия с маркери, вероятно за живописна цел. Оста X е надписана „Rank“ и е скалирана линейно от 4 до 256, като етикетите показват стойностите 4, 16, 64 и 256. Оста Y е надписана „Traces × 10⁻⁵ (COPA)“ и е скалирана линейно от 0.0 до 8.0.  Линията е черна, със стил плътна, и има квадратни маркери в краищата, всеки от които показва грешката на измерването. Линията започва в точката (4, 0.25) и се покачва постепенно до точката (256, 7.75), образувайки нарастващ тренд.  На графиката е показана само една линия.
model_annotations.English: The plot illustrates a relationship between rank and a trace value multiplied by 10^-5. The x-axis is labeled “Rank” and uses a linear scale ranging from 4 to 256, with numeric tick labels at intervals of 64. The y-axis is labeled "(COPA)" and uses a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to 8.0, with numeric tick labels at intervals of 4.0. A single black line with square markers and a solid line style is shown. The line begins at approximately 0.12 on the y-axis when the x-axis is at 4, increases to approximately 3.2 at x=64, and then increases to approximately 8.1 at x=256. Error bars are present at each data point, with the top of the error bars at approximately 0.25 at x=4, 3.8 at x=64, and 8.4 at x=256.
model_annotations.German: Das Diagramm stellt die Beziehung zwischen Rang und Traces × 10⁻⁵ (COPA) dar. Die x-Achse ist linear skaliert und reicht von 4 bis 256, wobei die Tick-Beschriftungen regelmäßig geordnet sind. Die y-Achse ist ebenfalls linear skaliert und reicht von 0,0 bis 8,0. Eine einzelne Linie ist im Diagramm dargestellt, sie ist schwarz, mit quadratischen Markierungen und einem durchgehenden Linienstil. Der Linienstil beginnt bei 0,03 bei einem Rang von 4 steigt kontinuierlich an auf 0,34 bei einem Rang von 16, von 0,34 auf 3,19 bei einem Rang von 64 und endet mit 7,77 bei einem Rang von 256, mit einem Fehlerbalken, der bei 256 vorhanden ist.
